Text: Full name is required; Arabic and English letters and spaces only, 2 to 50 characters; no digits or symbols.
fullName is a string with maxLength 50.
Mobile number is required: 05 followed by 8 digits only (API pattern ^05[0-9]{8}$). Spaces are removed before checking; Arabic-Indic digits are converted to 0-9. It is the identifier of the account.
No email field on the sign-up screen in this release; email can be added later in the profile. (API still lists an optional email.)
Notes: GAP-SIGNUP-013; welcome email open in GAP-SIGNUP-012

Text: Password must be at least 8 characters, at most 64, with at least one letter and one digit, and must not equal the mobile number. API and web page must be fixed to 8.
password is required; the API must require minLength 8 (documented 6 is wrong and will be fixed).
Date of birth is required; customers must be 18 or older.
Notes: GAP-SIGNUP-003; age calculation basis open in GAP-SIGNUP-015

Text: As a visitor aged 16 or older I can create an account; the account is created after the mobile number is verified.
Notes: US-1 (16) will be corrected to 18; see REQ-SIGNUP-007. GAP-SIGNUP-003

Source: prd.pdf R6; user-stories.docx US-5; openapi.yaml POST /v1/signup
Text: The customer chooses Arabic or English (ar/en required in API). Default language is the device language if Arabic or English, otherwise Arabic. Arabic uses a right-to-left layout; all screens appear in the chosen language.
The customer must accept the Terms and Conditions before signing up. The API receives a termsVersion field; the mock-up will add a checkbox.
Notes: GAP-SIGNUP-006; text and version open in GAP-SIGNUP-007

Text: A mobile number that is already registered cannot be used to sign up again (API 409). Message: 'This mobile number is already registered. Log in instead?' (Arabic: هذا الرقم مسجل مسبقاً. هل تريد تسجيل الدخول؟). If the earlier account is still pending, a new OTP is sent to finish that sign-up.
A visitor without a Saudi mobile number can sign up with email instead; a verification link is sent to the email.
Notes: Email sign-up is out of scope for this release. GAP-SIGNUP-004

Text: After the form is submitted a pending account is created and an OTP is sent by SMS.
A wrong OTP shows an error (API 400). 3 wrong attempts are allowed per code; after that the code is invalid and a new code must be requested.
The OTP has 6 digits; the API must accept 6 digits (documented 4 will be fixed). Mock-up and web page show six boxes.
An expired code returns 410. The OTP expires after 5 minutes; the screen shows 'The code has expired. Request a new code.'

Source: prd.pdf R11; user-stories.docx US-3; openapi.yaml POST /v1/otp/resend
Text: The customer can request a new OTP (202). Resend is possible after 30 seconds, at most 3 times per hour; a new code makes the old one invalid; 429 after the limit.
When the number is verified the account is created/active and the customer is logged in (API returns accessToken and points).

Source: prd.pdf R13; user-stories.docx US-4; openapi.yaml POST /v1/otp/verify 200
Text: Every new member receives a fixed 50 welcome points, credited once right after successful verification; balance shows 50.
Customers log in with mobile number and password.
Notes: Login belongs to the LOGIN module. GAP-SIGNUP-023

Text: The account is locked after several failed login attempts.
Notes: Belongs to the LOGIN module. GAP-SIGNUP-024

Text: Personal data is stored securely.
Registration must be fast.
The sign-up screens must be user-friendly.
Users are new customers in Saudi Arabia who are 18 or older.
Error messages will be delivered by the content team by sprint 15. Until then use the messages confirmed in the gap answers; every message needs Arabic and English.

Verify screen with six code boxes; Verify button; Resend code link. Wording follows the web page: heading 'Verify your mobile number', text 'We sent a code by SMS. Enter it below.'
